title: Casemiro not thinking about reversing Manchester United decision
content:
Manchester United’s Casemiro says he is not thinking about reversing his decision to leave the club at the end of this season.

Earlier this week, The Athletic reported that MLS sides Inter Miami and LA Galaxy were interested in signing the midfielder on a free transfer when his contract runs out in June.

The 34-year-old confirmed his intention to leave United on January 22, but has seen an upturn in form since that announcement.

After scoring United’s opening goal against Aston Villa on March 15, and then again when he was substituted late on, fans at Old Trafford sang “one more year, one more year, Casemiro”.

“I am still enjoying it a lot (in Manchester),” Casemiro said after Brazil’s 2-1 defeat by France in Boston on Thursday. “I believe the announcement is now done. It is huge, the affection that the fans have shown towards me.

“But I do really believe the decision is made and done. I am enjoying myself right now. I believe it will be some difficult (emotional) moments, these (final) games at Manchester United.”

Casemiro does have a one-year extension clause in his United contract — which could have been triggered if he started a certain number of games for them this season, believed to be 35 — however, the club will not be activating it.

His salary has been £15million per year for the three seasons (including the current one) he has been at United when the club have not been in the Champions League, and £18m in the one season they were in Europe’s top club competition (2023-24).

The Brazilian’s strong form has coincided with the arrival of Michael Carrick as United head coach, replacing Ruben Amorim, on January 13. United have moved away from playing three at the back, with Casemiro and Kobbie Mainoo forming a midfield partnership in Carrick’s 4-2-3-1 which has seen the team rise to third in the Premier League with seven games remaining.

“Above all, Michael is a specialist in my position on the field, he was a truly great player,” Casemiro added. “That makes everything much easier and he is always talking to us.

“I feel like we are in a good dynamic right now in Manchester and my objective now is to get the club back into the Champions League.”

Casemiro will play another friendly with Brazil against Croatia in the United States on Tuesday, before returning to England.

United do not have a Premier League game until the visit of Leeds United on April 13, with Carrick’s side set for a training camp in Dublin, Republic of Ireland at the start of next month.
